verdict.rationale: Railway deploys ordinary code straight from a repo with auto-config and "no new tools to learn", and it supports running apps closer to users and migrating from Heroku. Together these imply code is not tied to proprietary runtime APIs, but the pack never documents standard runtime APIs or portability across edge platforms. missing for 10: explicit documentation of standards-based runtime APIs, evidence that the same code runs unmodified on other edge platforms, a statement on avoiding proprietary storage APIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
